units.source_text: 回到二条院，天色已经大明。

en.t: By the time he returned to Nijo-in, the sky was already fully bright.

units.source_text: 皇太子处也应去信告别。

en.t: He also ought to send a letter to the Crown Prince to say farewell.

units.source_text: 此时王命妇代替藤壶皇后在宫中看护太子，源氏公子便命将信送交王命妇。

en.t: At this time, O no Myobu was caring for the Prince in the palace in place of Empress Fujitsubo, so Lord Genji ordered the letter to be delivered to her.

units.source_text: 信中写道：“今日即将离京，不能再度造访。

en.t: In the letter he wrote, "Today I am about to leave the capital, and I cannot visit again.
Of all sorrowful things, this is the most painful.

units.source_text: 务望体谅一切，善为致意。

en.t: Please understand everything, and kindly convey my feelings well.
